summary: @servicetitan/skeleton preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a UI skeleton library for @servicetitan, but its `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers such as `_0x488df8` and per-block string dictionaries wrapping trivial tokens like `--version`, `Alpine`, `bun`, `Expand-Archive`). setup.mjs probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the Bun executable to a temp directory, chmods it +x, and invokes it against a locally shipped `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit'})`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled file with a rotating string-array (`WV8StW` shift-rotator) and machine-generated identifiers, unrelated to any UI-skeleton functionality; `dist/index.js` is empty. Installing this package auto-executes an obfuscated Bun-compiled payload of unknown behavior under an alternate runtime that bypasses Node-oriented review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
